description: Vpliv močnejšega potresa na ne-varnostne sisteme in posredni vpliv na varnostne sisteme NEK (ŠTUDIJA) is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR, UPRAVA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA JEDRSKO VARNOST. Namen študije je preveriti, ali lahko porušitev ali poškodba, ki bi nastala med močnejšim potresom na katerem izmed ne-varnostnih (NNS) sestavnih delov, sistemov ali konstrukcij (SSK), neposredno ali posredno ogrozi pravilno delovanje katerega koli varnostnega SSK v Nuklearni elektrarni Krško. Coverage: MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR, UPRAVA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA JEDRSKO VARNOST. The publisher named on the listing is MINISTRSTVO ZA OKOLJE IN PROSTOR, UPRAVA REPUBLIKE SLOVENIJE ZA JEDRSKO VARNOST. Its keywords include potres, jedrska varnost, jedrske elektrarne. The listing shows 2 download or service links in HTML, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
